help.slack: Create a Slack app with the bot scopes chat:write and im:write (verification codes), turn on Interactivity with the Request URL shown on the connection. For chat triggers, also add app_mentions:read and im:history and turn on Event Subscriptions. Each workspace is its own connection.
help.telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather, save its token, then register the webhook (needs a public https STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL).
help.whatsapp: In a Meta app with the WhatsApp product, copy the access token, the phone number ID and the app secret, and choose a verify token. Then set the webhook in the Meta dashboard to the callback URL below with that verify token, and subscribe to "messages". Button messages only reach people who wrote to the number in the last 24 hours; outside that window, give an approved template with two quick-reply buttons (Approve, Reject).
help.email: Sends the request through the studio's SMTP settings (SMTP_HOST) with Approve / Reject links. Whoever answers signs in to the studio, so there is no account to link. Needs STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL.
help.teams: In Teams, add the Workflows template "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" and paste its URL here. The card's buttons open the studio, where the approver signs in. Needs STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL.

approvals.publicUrlMissing: STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL is not set: the platform must reach this server at a public https address.
approvals.identitiesHelp: Link your chat accounts so a button you press in Slack or Telegram counts as you. Slack accounts are linked per workspace. The bot sends a one-time code to the account; type it here to verify. Only the run owner and the approvers listed on the Human node can approve.

settings.title: Settings
